_comment: Shared by the API's ProductionShapesTests and the UI's production-shapes spec (add-indicator-column-metadata, design D13). One entry per shape of widget that a real project's dashboards use, with invented names and values that keep only the structure. "stored" is the config text the API writes (the WidgetConfig serialization), not what PostgreSQL gives back. The goldens were written from the code before the changes of the widget and dashboard program: "query" is WidgetQuery.For as JSON, "plan" the SQL texts and parameter names of IndicatorQueryBuilder.Plan, "saved" and "uiQuery" the UI's savedConfig and queryFor, "formSaved" what the widget form sends when it is saved without a change. "dashboard" holds a dashboard's settings and the golden text of its version content. Later changes add shapes and regenerate no golden.

shapes.name: ratio column chart sorted by orden as text

main.sql:
SELECT "zona"::text, (sum("numerator")::double precision / nullif(sum("denominator"), 0)), NULL::text
FROM "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"
WHERE ("numerator" IS NOT NULL OR "denominator" IS NOT NULL) AND "canal"::text = @f0
GROUP BY "zona"
HAVING (sum("numerator")::double precision / nullif(sum("denominator"), 0)) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY min(NULLIF("orden"::text, '')) ASC NULLS LAST, "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"."zona" NULLS LAST
LIMIT @limit

shapes.name: measure column chart with a series in percent over counts

domain.sql:
(SELECT "canal"::text, (sum("conteo")::double precision) FROM "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"
 WHERE "conteo" IS NOT NULL AND "canal" IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY "canal" ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST, 1 LIMIT @cap)
UNION ALL
(SELECT NULL::text, (sum("conteo")::double precision) FROM "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"
 WHERE "conteo" IS NOT NULL AND "canal" IS NULL
 HAVING count(*) > 0)

cells.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy".*, CASE WHEN "canal"::text = ANY(@kept) THEN "canal"::text END AS "__series", CASE WHEN "canal" IS NULL THEN 'none' WHEN "canal"::text = ANY(@kept) THEN 'value' ELSE 'other' END AS "__kind"
  FROM "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"
  WHERE "conteo" IS NOT NULL
),
grp AS (
  SELECT "zona" AS g, (sum("conteo")::double precision) AS v, count(*) AS n, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY src."zona" NULLS LAST) AS rk
  FROM src GROUP BY "zona" HAVING (sum("conteo")::double precision) IS NOT NULL
),
cell AS (
  SELECT "zona" AS g, "__kind" AS k, "__series" AS s, (sum("conteo")::double precision) AS v, count(*) AS n
  FROM src GROUP BY "zona", "__kind", "__series" HAVING (sum("conteo")::double precision) IS NOT NULL
)
(SELECT 0 AS part, g::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, v, n, rk FROM grp ORDER BY rk LIMIT @limit)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 1, cell.g::text, cell.k, cell.s, cell.v, cell.n, grp.rk
 FROM cell JOIN grp ON cell.g IS NOT DISTINCT FROM grp.g
 ORDER BY grp.rk, cell.k, cell.s LIMIT @limit)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 2, NULL::text, "__kind", "__series", (sum("conteo")::double precision), count(*), NULL::bigint
 FROM src GROUP BY "__kind", "__series")
UNION ALL
(SELECT 3, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, (sum("conteo")::double precision), count(*), NULL::bigint FROM src)

shapes.name: box plot grouped by a column with kept colors

boxes.sql:
WITH src AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT "grupo" AS g, ("puntaje"::double precision) AS x
  FROM "p_x_indicators"."encuesta_hoy"
  WHERE "puntaje" IS NOT NULL AND ("puntaje"::double precision) > '-Infinity'::double precision AND ("puntaje"::double precision) < 'Infinity'::double precision
),
box AS (
  SELECT g, row_number() OVER () AS b, count(*) AS n, min(x) AS lo, max(x) AS hi, sum(x) / count(*) AS mean,
         percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS q
  FROM src GROUP BY g
),
fence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT box.*, q[1] - 1.5 * (q[3] - q[1]) AS lf, q[3] + 1.5 * (q[3] - q[1]) AS uf FROM box
),
marked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.b, s.x, f.q[2] AS med, (s.x < f.lf OR s.x > f.uf) AS is_out
  FROM src s JOIN fence f ON s.g = f.g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.b, s.x, f.q[2], (s.x < f.lf OR s.x > f.uf)
  FROM src s JOIN fence f ON f.g IS NULL WHERE s.g IS NULL
),
ends AS (
  SELECT b, min(x) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_out) AS lw, max(x) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_out) AS uw, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_out) AS outliers
  FROM marked GROUP BY b
),
shown AS (
  SELECT b, array_agg(x ORDER BY x) AS xs
  FROM (SELECT b, x, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY abs(x - med) DESC, x) AS r FROM marked WHERE is_out) far
  WHERE r <= @maxoutliers
  GROUP BY b
)
SELECT f.g::text, f.n, f.lo, f.q, f.hi, f.mean, e.lw, e.uw, e.outliers, s.xs
FROM fence f JOIN ends e USING (b) LEFT JOIN shown s USING (b)
ORDER BY f.q[2] ASC, f.g NULLS LAST
LIMIT @limit

declared._comment: Invented column maps (add-small-sample-warnings, design D15), each what an indicator could declare for the columns of these shapes: "base" (the column that counts the units a row stands for), "missing" (values that mean no data) and "categories" (the columns of a long table that name a question and its answers). The API's ProductionShapesTests plans every shape again with each map and no setting on: the plotted statements, once the figure outputs are removed, stay each shape's "plan" golden, and a widget that does not ask for it leaves nothing out. Later changes add maps or shapes and regenerate no golden.
